address: 86 Soi Chan 44, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: From early morning until late afternoon, locals flock to the small room at the front and large dining area at the rear. Enjoy guay jub as an entrée or in a sweet, peppery rice noodle broth; rich layers of soft pork are encased in a crispy skin. Can be ordered with or without pork offal....
